test_title: PYST 2: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A and B can do a piece of work in eight days and B alone can do it in 16 days. In how many days, can A do it alone?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B can do a piece of work in 8 days.

B alone can do it 
in 16 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by A and B together in one day = 1/8

Work done by B alone in one day = 1/16

Work done by A alone in one day = (Work done by A and B together in one day) - (Work done by B alone in one day)

Number of days A alone can do the work = 1 / (Work done by A alone in one day)

**Calculation:**

Work done by A and B together in one day = 1/8

Work done by B alone in one day = 1/16

Work done by A alone in one day = (1/8) - (1/16)

⇒ Work done by A alone in one day = (2/16) - (1/16)

⇒ Work done by A alone in one day = 1/16

Number of days A alone can do the work = 1 / (1/16)

⇒ Number of days A alone can do the work = 16

**The correct answer is option 3: 16 days.**
